# 316 Capital

> 316 Capital is a licensed lending brokerage and capital advisory firm for real estate investors. We arrange business-purpose financing through institutional capital providers.

## What we do

We help real estate investors structure and place fix and flip, BRRRR, ground up construction, bridge and DSCR rental financing. Borrowers work with one point of contact from pricing through closing.

## Financing products

- Fix and flip: acquisition and draw-based renovation financing.
- BRRRR: acquisition and rehab financing designed around a later rental refinance.
- Ground up construction: financing for new residential construction.
- Bridge: short-term business-purpose acquisition and refinance financing.
- DSCR rental: long-term financing for income-producing rental property.

## Important facts

316 Capital is a broker, not a direct lender. Financing is business purpose only and is not available for owner-occupied primary residences. Pricing and terms vary by borrower, property, product and institutional capital provider. Request transaction-specific pricing rather than relying on a general number.
